input.content:
Biogas plant BGA6 is a two-stage energy-crop plant that uses no slurry. A solid feeder with a 45 cubic metre hopper, a hydraulic push-floor and a press screw charges the plug-flow digester directly through its front face. Press water from the separation stage is recirculated to mash the solids.

Digester F1 is a horizontal steel tank of plug-flow design, 32 m long, 6 m wide and 4.5 m high (gross volume 864 cubic metres), with a slow-running reel agitator along its longitudinal axis and heating registers in the wall and floor. It runs thermophilically at 52 degrees Celsius (325.15 K) with a fill level of 90 percent; its gas space is the headspace only, approx. 86 cubic metres, and the gas is led through the gas collecting pipe into the gas space of the post-digester. The digestate passes into post-digester N1, a round tank of 22 m diameter and 6 m height fitted with one paddle agitator, one long-axis agitator and a dome roof with a gas space (including headspace) of 505 cubic metres, heated to 42 degrees Celsius (315.15 K), fill level 90 percent. At the outlet of N1 a screw press separates the digestate; the solid fraction is hauled away, about 10 cubic metres per day of press water flow back into F1 and the remainder into digestate store G1 (26 m diameter, 6 m height, two submersible agitators, unheated at approx. 20 degrees Celsius, fill level 90 percent, gas space including headspace 719 cubic metres).

Air is blown into the gas space of the post-digester for biological desulphurisation. The biogas is converted in a CHP unit with a rated electrical output of 360 kW (electrical 41 percent, thermal 43 percent). An emergency flare rated 250 cubic metres per hour is available for fault conditions; a condensate shaft sits on the gas collecting pipe.

Substrate feed: 14 t/d maize silage, 4 t/d whole-crop silage and 3 t/d solid cattle manure through the solid feeder into F1 plus approx. 10 cubic metres per day of recirculated press water into F1.
